title: Skip only hop of __torch_function__ at a time
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.12.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #177530
* #177533

Closes #55093

This changes `Tensor.__torch_function__` to skip only one level of
`__torch_function__` calls. This is achieved by adding a new state variable
`skip_next_torch_function` which is reset to false every time
`has_torch_function` is checked, which works both in C++ and Python.

In the issue we discussed making `DisableTorchFunction` public, but with this
you can just write `super().__torch_function__(func, types, args, kwargs)`
to achieve the intended effect whilst being clear that this is
intended for use in `__torch_function__` implementations only.

This revives https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/74728

Signed-off-by: Edward Z. Yang <ezyang@meta.com>
